summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature across rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and CHANGELOG.md, per the spec. Added private _ProgressReader and _ProgressFileContext, module-level open and wrap_file, and Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file. Added 22 tests before the script-entry block, two docs subsections, and a changelog bullet linking PR 1759. Nothing was committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run, since the task forbade running repository code. Open risks: module-level open passes a str mode to the Literal-overloaded Progress.open, which mypy may flag; the suppression categories are per the spec but unconfirmed by a type-checker run.
